content_estimate.excludes: hash-map spare buckets/control bytes, B-tree slack, allocator metadata/retention, SQLite/native cache, stacks and other runtime allocations; no configured capacity is credited as owned bytes
content_estimate.limitation: Conservative content estimate, not a heap profile; below the 80% attribution gate.

discarded_709_setup.reason: Fresh peer admitted only one destination until671.324s, versus125.116s in the control; its measured ingress was unmatched through the second-pass anchor. Stopped setup trial, excluded from the full-hour comparison.
discarded_709_setup.replacement_setup: Copy default control peer/identity into a fresh peer directory before existing harness start; verify public destinations and actual rate.

limitations: Initial file-cache ownership differs even in the static-musl pair; high-event/read-byte changes are not isolated allocator causality.
GNU and musl are not interchangeable allocator controls.
One maintenance cycle does not prove repeated ratcheting or multi-hour production stability.
Stack #708 merged the allocator evaluation. #709 requested-byte measurement and local repeated-cycle outcomes do not establish production memory acceptance.

limits.announce_rate_note: One announce_now invocation per second can announce multiple destinations; actual admitted duplicate-filter hash rates are recorded per run.
limits.duration_note: Original comparisons are 600 s; heap-3600 and conditional purge-3600 override to 3600 s after readiness with the same fixture and limits.

raw_artifact_path_note: target paths are original local acquisition locations; the committed review bundle contains portable raw files and frozen analysis/harness snapshots.

heap-3600.coverage_definition: all expected complete windows present; 5s nominal cadence, first/last within 10s of edges and every internal gap <= 10s
heap-3600.environment_scope: No MIMALLOC overrides in measured daemon or announce peer; both inherit existing harness environment.
measurement_limits: Requested Rust sizes and resident anon are different measures; their signed residual has no named owner.
Content estimate and configured SQLite targets are not additional measured owners.
Five-second snapshots can miss short-lived allocations; maxima are sampled, not high-water counters.
Client overflow_policy=reject and announce-parser/queue-rejection warnings occur; zero poll/phase errors do not establish delivery.
Initial file-cache ownership and unrelated host work are not controlled; both daemon processes use the same allocator binary.
First pass removes 600000 peer-history rows and 75000 payloads; subsequent passes remove no rows without fresh-message load.
The final partial window is reported separately and excluded from full-window gates; no multi-hour production acceptance.
heap-3600.phase_count_assumption: ingress profile drives announces and SDK polls only; phase runs are scheduled invocations, valid as completed successful passes only with zero phase errors
heap-3600.requested_flat_definition: max minus min complete-window median <= 1 MiB; not proof of absence of leaks
heap-3600.resident_owner_80_percent_gate: unresolved: requested sizes and anon RSS are different measures; no SQLite allowance or residual is credited as an owner
